messages.text: Billing ops: the Q2 billing policy document is the governing reference for all enterprise true-up questions this cycle. Please follow it closely, especially on account classification and overage cap rules. Any exceptions need to go through the formal amendment process.

Reminder for the billing run: Dunmore Capital Partners is classified as an internal cost center under the parent entity agreement with Dunmore Holdings Group. They are not in scope for the enterprise true-up. Their Q2 compute costs go through the annual parent-entity allocation.
Team – Hartwell SLA credit for INC-8841 has been authorized by VP Support. Signed authorization form is in the billing ops data folder. Apply it to their Q2 true-up before we close the run.
Got it, will pull the authorized amount from the signed form and apply it.
